local_review.finding_body: Review Signal #4 is violated in tests/src/io.micronaut/micronaut-http-server/5.1.13/build.gradle: the Netty server, HTTP client, and Jackson databind companion dependencies hardcode 5.1.13. This prevents the suite from resolving those matching Micronaut modules at the TCK-selected tested version when the same test is reused for later supported versions.
local_review.finding_title: Companion dependencies pin the tested library version
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the three hardcoded 5.1.13 companion dependency versions with $libraryVersion so they track the TCK-selected Micronaut version. Verified the correction with targeted metadata validation, Checkstyle, Java compilation, and JVM tests.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the full eventual PR diff and local evidence for the single io.micronaut:micronaut-http-server:5.1.13 coordinate. The test exercises real Micronaut HTTP server behavior, runs without Native Image skips or tolerated failures, uses a separate test package, and applies bounded 10-second HTTP timeouts. The only metadata files are reachability-metadata.json files. Reported dynamic access is 0/0, which is a valid no-calls case, so no percentage or entry-count mismatch gate applies. Local index gates were green, and the repaired tree passes checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, compileTestJava, and javaTest for the target coordinate. The repaired tree is approved.
